dog.description_text:
Meet Pilot! All aboard for a brand-new adventure! This boy was rescued from a heartbreaking hoarding situation in Georgia, and now he's ready to set a course for a brighter future. His destination? A loving forever home with people who will give him the chance to feel safe, cherished, and included in all the fun. Every great journey starts somewhere, and Pilot is hoping his next stop is your home. Will you be his co-pilot for life?

Every bio is just a snapshot of the animal. For more information about Pilot and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home, please reach out to our Adoptions Team.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
